title: factdiff.py anchors can fail below a located share, so a goal's share figure is read by a check
goal: factdiff.py anchors --min SHARE exits 1 when the located share of the fact-source pairs whose source returned text is below SHARE, so an item whose goal raises the share has a check that reads the figure

run:
import subprocess, sys
run = lambda m: subprocess.run([sys.executable, '_tools/factdiff.py', 'anchors', '--min', m], capture_output=True, text=True)
hi, lo = run('1.01'), run('0')
print('--min 1.01 exit', hi.returncode, '| --min 0 exit', lo.returncode, (hi.stdout + hi.stderr).strip().splitlines()[-1:])
sys.exit(0 if hi.returncode == 1 and lo.returncode == 0 else 1)

gates.question: How does factdiff.py anchors --min take its share and combine with other listings?

notes: 2026-10-20 planning: answers SP-ilje65fa, where ST-kbrsd24q's check factdiff.py anchors exited 0 whatever the share. The fixed source set of the old goal is --source, which anchors has. Premise: --min is unknown (exit 2).
